title: Replay T385 through release and audit R437 complete-stream COPY
body:
## Change and mathematical scope

Completes the two explicitly assigned follow-ups to #3883 in one new package, research/t385-r437-copy-audit. No supplier admission or selected-frontier change.

- T385: fresh one-job wrapper at #3802 head de2cd5c58009205210e3bf328b0ef5cadf3903af completed all seven stages, including release, with PASS_T385_COMPLETE_CONDITIONAL_RELEASE and exit 0. Retained supervisor interval: 2946.086 seconds; summed scientific stage durations: 2923.426 seconds. Native suppliers and ancestry are explicitly reused, with source-bound runtime adaptations recorded. This closes the prior timeout gap, not the inherited native/all-size proof obligations.
- R437: an independent standard-library implementation reconstructs 636 frame projectors and exact address pullbacks on all 659 arbitrary input functions in both literal programs. Seven semantic controls reject. At forward center 475/frame 515, constant-one dirty input 340 separates complete COPY from the weaker predecessor named-dirt-only contract.
- The complete finite invoice reconstructs 125856 helper-owner occurrences, all 903456 edges and fallback/precision charges. Across 288 calls: 2592 rank-seven COPY episodes and 2592 separately charged linear disposals. This is finite accounting under the inherited tariff. Uniform child cost/scratch, tape/routing, volume normalization and precision/recovery remain conditional. CALLER-BOUNDARY.md traces the existing concrete caller and its reduced fixtures.

Predecessor scientific head #3883: b122e6ceab16bc1c6df818490ea5a21e864e0786; its current unrelated workflow change is preserved.

Initial claim: https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/discussions/1166#discussioncomment-19030424. Final open-PR refresh at 04:59 UTC found 638 unique entries over seven pages; #3700/#3802/#3815/#3857/#3875/#3890 overlap is recorded. Discussion coverage is partial. Added coverage is the completed fresh wrapper and changed-head complete-stream/cost audit.

## Validation

CPython 3.12.3. T385 dependency versions, commands, hashes, stage logs, timeout extensions and original/normalized evidence digests are retained in T385-EXECUTION.json and EVIDENCE.json. R437 normal and optimized runs pass, plus actual optimized Git-free export with four changed/missing/symlink/falsified-receipt controls. The recorded T385 checker passes three execution-coverage controls. Baseline source binding and package metadata pass. Published commit 125f5afad680ef128e386fa58e76eef5fadaa5d6 passes exact 81-file byte/source-history verification and diff checks.

Reproduce: python3 -B scripts/research_package.py --package research/t385-r437-copy-audit. This recomputes R437 and authenticates retained T385 evidence; it does not rerun the long wrapper. No fresh native rebuild, full selected cold replay, formal-kernel verification or independent human review is claimed.
